mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_instruction_line (id, instruction_id, line_no, accounting_rule_line_id, manual_adjustment_line_id, account_id, entry_side, amount, create_time) VALUES (#{line.id}, #{line.instructionId}, #{line.lineNo}, #{line.accountingRuleLineId}, #{line.manualAdjustmentLineId}, #{line.accountId}, #{line.entrySide}, #{line.amount}, #{line.createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, instruction_id, line_no, accounting_rule_line_id, manual_adjustment_line_id, account_id, entry_side, amount, create_time FROM t_instruction_line WHERE instruction_id = #{instructionId} ORDER BY line_no
